newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-OPENER GARRICK GETS FIRST WEST INDIES CALL-UP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-OPENER GARRICK GETS FIRST WEST INDIES CALL-UP.

text.p: Young opener Leon Garrick has been called up for the first time by West Indies in his debut season in first-class cricket.
Garrick is in West Indies' squad of 13 for the third one-day match against India in Kingstown, St Vincent, on Wednesday.
The 20-year-old Jamaican batsman has already scored two centuries - 138 in a Red Stripe Cup match against Trinidad and Tobago and 108 for Jamaica in India's opening tour match.
Garrick gets his chance after Phil Simmons, originally picked for the first two one games, was sidelined by injury.
The two teams are level 1-1 in the four-match series.

Squad: Courtney Walsh (captain), Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Jimmy Adams, Leon Garrick, Courtney Browne, Ottis Gibson, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose, Mervyn Dillon.
